attempts.prompt: A person holding a smartphone at eye level and arm's length to take a straight-on selfie, with head level and relaxed face, photographed from the side in an evenly lit room. A second, smaller inset shows the same person holding the phone tilted and too low, to contrast correct and incorrect photo setup, with no text labels.
issues: The main image does not show the correct setup: the phone is held above head height with the arm raised and the head tilted slightly up, rather than at eye level and arm's length with a level head.
The phone is too high and not aligned with the eyes, so the main image gives a misleading contrast with the inset.
The inset is ambiguous: the phone is held at roughly face height, not clearly tilted and too low, so the correct vs. incorrect contrast is weak.
Side-profile framing makes it unclear how the phone camera relates to the face, so the image does not clearly illustrate fair canthal tilt self-check positioning.
